source: Mount Sinai Brain Bank; dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
measurement: Deposited unnormalized raw read abundances, including fractional values; RPKM columns excluded

covariate_source.mapping: RNA-seq sample numbers 1-8 are C1-C8 and 9-17 are A9-A17; RNA-seq batch column
covariate_source.excluded_covariates: Age and PMI use within-group patient numbering without an explicit RNA-seq sample crosswalk; sex is not reported. No individual-level mapping is inferred.
